description: This file contains utility functions for object detection using YOLOv3, including image preprocessing, bounding box drawing, IoU calculation, prediction transformation, and non-maximum suppression.

methods.name: draw_bbox_and_label
methods.description: Draws a bounding box and label on an image.

methods.name: letterbox_image
methods.description: Resizes an image while keeping aspect ratio, filling extra space with gray.

methods.name: prepare_image
methods.description: Prepares an image tensor for input into the YOLO model.

methods.name: bbox_iou
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) between two bounding boxes.

methods.name: transform_prediction
methods.description: Transforms raw model predictions into bounding box coordinates and class probabilities.

methods.name: get_predictions
methods.description: Filters predictions based on confidence threshold and applies non-maximum suppression.
